The query library uses local copies of N3.js (`n3.min.js`), jsonld.js
(`jsonld.min.js`), rdflib.js (`rdflib.min.js`), and JSZip (`jszip.min.js`).
These files were copied unchanged from the ReasonLynx vendor directory when
porting the query library. Preserve the license notices embedded in each file.
SPARQL.js and Cytoscape were already vendored by this application.
